query:
INSERT INTO subscriptions (
                user_id,
                provider,
                provider_subscription_id,
                plan,
                expires_at
            )
            VALUES (
                $1,
                $2::text::subscription_provider,
                $3,
                $4::text::user_plan,
                $5
            )
            RETURNING
                id,
                user_id,
                provider::text AS "provider!: String",
                provider_subscription_id,
                status::text AS "status!: String",
                plan::text AS "plan!: String",
                started_at,
                expires_at,
                created_at,
                updated_at
